description: 宾得于2010年推出的数码单反相机。配备Interchangeable Pentax KAF2 mount compatible with Pentax auto-aperture lenses and SDM lenses; older lenses supported in stop-down metering mode.。快门速度| shutterRange = 1/6000 sec – 30 sec, Bulb。

specs.电池: Rechargeable Li-Ion battery D-LI109, AA Battery Holder D-BH109 (optional) for 4× AA batteries
